subject: Post-discovery: next demo (30m) — pick 2–3 windows and SME nominees
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@pharmix.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: next demo (30m) — pick 2–3 windows and SME nominees

Hi Alex (and Lindsey),

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on latency targets for batch inference and your internal gating criteria for model explainability. Quick recap attached (discovery-notes.pdf) with the points we captured:

- Main priority: reduce inference cost-per-call while keeping 95th-p90 latency <= 250ms for short prompts.
- Compliance: need audit logs retained for 12 months and KMS integration for key management.
- Success criteria: pilot with 3 endpoints, <20% cost delta vs baseline, and pass two smoke prompts from your QA set.

Next step: product walkthrough (30 minutes) focused on architecture, routing/fallback policies, and ops/observability. Can you propose 2–3 windows over the next 7–10 business days that work for the stakeholders below? Prefer US/PST times if possible.

Please include who will join from your side (engineering SME, product manager, procurement if needed). From our side I’ll bring Priyom (solutions engineer) and Ben (commercial).

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) 5m – quick recap & objectives
2) 15m – demo (routing, dedicated vs hosted, cost controls)
3) 5m – security/compliance callouts (audit logs, KMS)
4) 5m – next steps & mutual action plan

CC'ing Priyom and Ben to surface any pre-demo asks. I attached the success-criteria workbook to make it easy to confirm metrics ahead of the demo.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: 2028-07-25-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), pharmix-success-criteria.xlsx (workbook)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@pharmix.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lindsey Porter <lindsey.porter@pharmix.com>, Pharmix Procurement <procurement@pharmix.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 18:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: next demo (30m) — pick 2–3 windows and SME nominees

Thanks Kimberly — useful recap and the workbook looks helpful.

A few windows that look doable for our group (PST):
- Wed 2 Aug, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu 3 Aug, 1:30–2:00pm
- Mon 7 Aug, 11:00–11:30am

Tentative attendees from Pharmix: myself (product lead), Lindsey (engineering SME), and I flagged procurement in case contract questions come up — they may not join the first call. We also want to surface our security engineer (Arun) on the technical deep-dive if possible for the follow-up session.

One quick ask prior to the demo: can you show the audit-log export format and an example of how we would query token-level cost by API key? That’s a must-have to validate during the walkthrough.

If any of those slots work, pick one and we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Product | Pharmix Therapeutics
alex.nguyen@pharmix.com | (617) 555-2194

Hi Alex — thanks for the slots and the ask. Short answers:
- We can show the audit-log CSV export and a demo of token-level cost breakdown in the Console during the 30m. I’ll prepare a short snippet that filters by API key and shows cost trends over the last 30 days.
- For the initial 30m session we’ll keep it high-level but will call out how follow-up technical deep dives can include Arun (security) and a workshop for the KMS/HSM flow.

All three proposed slots look good on our end. Kimberly — can you confirm which one we want to send as the calendar hold? Also attaching a short pre-demo checklist (one-pager) so Pharmix can identify which prompts we should include in the smoke test.

Thanks,

Thanks everyone — invite on its way.
